connector.name: MarsNMe
connector.registryDescription: Agent-agnostic memory backend that preserves continuity between humans and AI over time.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-gateway. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the marsmanleo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MCP_PROFILE
env.description: Profile ID used to separate memory data (for example: profile-a).

env.name: JINA_API_KEY
env.description: Jina AI API key for embedding-based tools.

env.name: PORT
env.description: Local HTTP port for the MCP endpoint. If omitted, defaults by MCP_PROFILE (coco=18790, toto=18791, others deterministic in 20000-29999).
